summary: ```# Marvelous Designer 12 New Feature Demonstration: Editing Style Lines ## Introduction to Editing Style Lines 当选择造型线工具时，您已经创建的满片外线将会加粗显示，即为造型线。 ## Using the Editing Style Line Tool ### Overview 编辑造型线工具是用来整体缩放选择的造型线。 ### Adjusting the Plate 在3D窗口中点击并拖动造型线或造型线上的点以调整满片。 当您在3D窗口中调整满片后，它们也会同步在2D窗口中进行修改。 ## Molding Shape Tool ### Functionality The molding shape tool is used to adjust the plate in the 3D window. ### Drawing Molding Lines - Left-click on the outside of the plate or on the point on the outside of the plate to start drawing. - Gradually click to complete the creation of the molding line. ### Cutting and Sewing The plate will therefore be cut and sewn. Cancel the symmetrical relationship with the irregular editing plate. The symmetrical plate will create the shape line in a symmetrical way and cut and sew. ```
